note: Parks Canada campground (formerly Pocahontas) on the Miette Road just inside Jasper's east boundary, by the Hwy 16 junction about 45 km northeast of the Jasper townsite; the road continues to Miette Hot Springs. Five loops (B-F) in forest beside Mountain Creek, with tent-only walk-in sites off loops B and F and a short trail from loop B to Punchbowl Falls. --Claude
